purpose: Checkpoints of the configuration ablations in docs/08_results.md#ablations, versioned so an arm can be replayed without retraining it and its capacity is recorded somewhere other than the campaign script.
produced_by: no_dr / narrow_64 / wide_256: bash scripts/run_ablation_campaign.sh, then bash scripts/run_no_dr_extension.sh for the seeds no_dr carries past three; v3: bash scripts/run_v3_campaign.sh; spawn_cycle / symmetric: bash scripts/run_item16_campaign.sh
baseline: each arm's 'baseline' field: results/study (PyTorch, both experiments, 500000 steps, domain randomisation on, RL_HIDDEN_DIM=128, seeds 1-10) for the PyTorch-era arms, results/study_jax (the same on the JAX runtime) for v3 and the single-key arms
seed_coverage: each arm's 'seeds' field lists what its scratch actually holds, discovered per experiment rather than assumed; report_study.py pairs on seed number, so an arm with fewer seeds than the control is compared on the shared ones only
reproduce_training: bash scripts/run_ablation_campaign.sh, or one arm on its own: env RL_HIDDEN_DIM=64 python scripts/run_study.py --steps 500000 --seeds 1,2,3 --jobs 3 --eval-matches 150 --out data/runs_ablation_narrow_64 --results-dir results/ablation_narrow_64
